# TheRoundup

> > Comprehensive reviews and guides for sustainable living, featuring eco-friendly products, non-toxic certifications, and environmental impact analysis.

TheRoundup provides expert-driven product reviews and educational content focused on sustainable alternatives to everyday items, from PFAS-free cookware to biodegradable bags. Founded by contributors including James Miller and Arabella Ruiz, the site helps consumers make informed choices about non-toxic, eco-friendly products for home, personal care, and lifestyle.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable Living
- Non-Toxic Products
- PFAS and BPA-Free Materials
- Eco-Friendly Product Reviews
- Biodegradable and Compostable Materials
- Organic Bedding and Furniture
- Zero Waste Lifestyle
- Environmental Impact Analysis
- Green Certifications (GREENGUARD, MADE SAFE)
- Sustainable Fashion
- PLA (Polylactic Acid)
- Water Conservation
- Recycling Guides
- Chemical-Free Living
- Energy Efficiency

## Getting Started

- [TheRoundup | Sustainable Products | Eco-Friendly Lifestyle](https://theroundup.org): Homepage for sustainable living guides with eco-friendly product reviews

- [5 Safest Non-Toxic Cribs for a Chemical-Free Nursery [2026]](https://theroundup.org/non-toxic-cribs-chemical-free): GREENGUARD certified crib reviews including Babyletto and Oeuf Sparrow
- [Is Pine Wood Furniture Toxic? An Expert Guide - TheRoundup](https://theroundup.org/is-pine-wood-furniture-toxic): Expert analysis of pine wood furniture toxicity and safety considerations
- [What is a Refurbished Mattress & Should You Buy One Used?](https://theroundup.org/what-is-refurbished-mattress): Guide to pros and cons of buying refurbished mattresses by James Miller
